relationships.subject: Tomatidine
relationships.evidence_quote: Similar results were observed in Western blot and cellular immunofluorescence experiments, indicating Td can enhance the expression of Nrf2, as well as promote the expression of HO-1 and GPX4 (Figure 4D-G).

relationships.subject: Tomatidine
relationships.evidence_quote: Td alleviates IDD in vitro and in vivo by activating the Nrf2/HO-1/GPX4 pathway to inhibit ferroptosis in NPCs.

relationships.subject: Nrf2
relationships.evidence_quote: However, the effect of Td on NPCs was abolished after the knockdown of Nrf2 (Figure 6B-C).

key_findings: Tomatidine activated Nrf2/HO-1/GPX4, reduced oxidative stress and ferroptosis in LPS-treated NPCs, and ameliorated IDD in mice.
Nrf2 siRNA abolished the protective effects of Td.
